events.subtitle: Victor, Regi, Roy and Joseph Wooten
events.factual_description: All Good Presents and The Hamilton Live present The Wooten Brothers on Sunday, September 13, 2026 at The Hamilton Live, 600 14th Street NW in Washington, DC. Doors are at 6:30 PM and the show starts at 8:00 PM. The Hamilton lists a $45-$55 face-value range, while its authorized EVENTIM destination provides the exact event purchase path. The Wooten Brothers' official site identifies the self-contained current unit as Regi Wooten on guitar/vocals, Roy Wooten on drums/vocals, Joseph Wooten on keyboards/vocals and Victor Wooten on bass/vocals, and describes its current music as drawing from jazz, funk, soul and R&B. The same tour continues through Camden on September 14, Hartford on September 16 and Brooklyn on September 17, so no one-off scarcity is inferred.

en.why_it_matters: This is the Wootens as a self-contained family band rather than a Victor Wooten solo showcase: bass, guitar, drums and keyboards are distributed across four brothers whose language moves through fusion, funk, R&B and soul without giving up instrumental virtuosity. The draw is the interplay — hearing those roles lock together as one family rhythm section, with a shared vocabulary built over decades.
en.trip_verdict: If September 13 is open in the DMV, I would make room for The Hamilton and build the evening around it. The tour reaches Camden the next day and Brooklyn later that week, so there is no reason to chase the band outside DC.

es.why_it_matters: Aquí no se trata de Victor Wooten como solista con acompañantes, sino de los Wooten como una banda familiar autosuficiente: bajo, guitarra, batería y teclados repartidos entre cuatro hermanos cuyo lenguaje cruza fusión, funk, R&B y soul sin perder virtuosismo instrumental. Lo que importa es la interacción — escuchar cómo esos papeles embonan como una sola sección rítmica familiar, con un vocabulario compartido construido durante décadas.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 13 de septiembre está libre en el DMV, le haría espacio a The Hamilton y armaría la noche alrededor del concierto. La gira pasa por Camden al día siguiente y por Brooklyn esa misma semana, así que no hace falta perseguirlos fuera de DC.
